BHEL and Titagarh form joint venture for Vande Bharat sleeper train maintenance

Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) and Titagarh Rail Systems Limited have entered into a 50:50 joint venture to maintain the Vande Bharat sleeper train fleet. The agreement is for a duration of 35 years. This partnership aims to ensure the long-term upkeep of the new generation of sleeper trains.
